Automation: Rules reference · resolve effects at the table

You wait until their next stride has nowhere else to go, then drive the weapon across their chest and send them back down the path they chose.

Rules

Action
Reaction
Attribute
Fortitude
Target / range / shape
An enemy entering an adjacent square voluntarily.
Equipment / acquisition
Use an ordinary melee weapon (Bulk 1), supplied on learning if needed.
Type
Skill / Attack

After the enemy enters the adjacent square, make a Fortitude melee attack.

Weak
4 physical damage; push it 1 square back the way it came.
Standard
6 physical damage; push it 2 squares back the way it came.
Strong
8 physical damage; push it 3 squares back the way it came and apply Prone.
